builds.name: pokopia-native (xFractals)
builds.about: xFractals' Pokopia builder: builds only the ~3,800 shaders the game needs (about an hour), takes update v327680 or 2.0.1. The default.

builds.name: nxnative's engine
builds.about: Upstream nxnative's Pokopia profile (2.0.1 / v655360 only): builds all ~131,000 shaders, which takes hours (about 6.5 h on an M4 Max before its latest speed-ups) and over 200 GB of disk while it builds.

choose.why: pokopia-native builds in about an hour and has more player reports; nxnative's full build takes hours and over 200 GB of disk
